name: Wild Magic
summary: Sorcerers whose chaotic magic can surge unpredictably.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.short: Your leveled spells can trigger random surges.
features.summary: Immediately after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the DM can have you roll a d20; on a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table for a random magical effect.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.short: Gain advantage on one roll; the DM may trigger a surge to recharge it.
features.summary: You can gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check or saving throw. Once used, you regain it after a long rest, or when the DM has you roll on the surge table.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.short: Reaction, 2 sorcery points: add or subtract 1d4 from a roll.
features.summary: When another creature you can see makes an attack roll, ability check or saving throw, you can use your reaction and spend 2 sorcery points to roll 1d4 and add or subtract it from their roll.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.short: Roll twice on the surge table and pick.
features.summary: Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you can roll twice and use either number.

features.name: Spell Bombardment
features.short: When a damage die rolls max, roll it again.
features.summary: When you roll damage for a spell and roll the highest number possible on any die, choose one of those dice, roll it again and add the result. Once per turn.
